title: docs(ui): ui/AGENTS.md becomes a normative core; local-dev and flaky-test narrative move to the contributor guides
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmTYfaPbLQD4BJfomW

Part of #25919 (PR 2: the `ui/AGENTS.md` restructure. PR 1 landed as #26023.)
Ruling-ref: 6435359095 · 6485892110
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
skip-changeset: the diff touches only `ui/AGENTS.md` and `ui/.claude/**`. No package ships either.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`ui/AGENTS.md` 收成规范核心。本地开发、端口和多栈流程原样搬进 `console-development.md`，flaky 测试的成因、读数和前情原样搬进新的 `guides/flaky-tests.md`，核心里各留一行指针。新增两条写法规则，不加门禁。修了 5 处过期说法，并按契约复核的 S1 修正了 console 指南里的 MSW 说法。
- 为什么改：裁决 6435359095 和 6485892110 定了这次重构。核心只写规则，叙事放到主题页，过期说法会把 agent 带错路。
- 风险与回滚：只动文档，不动代码。27 行 ⛔ / never 全数留在核心。其中 26 行逐字节不变，第 27 行（#8）只按派发令补了 `packages/` 路径前缀。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- 先看：① `ui/AGENTS.md` §9 的两行新指针，加上 §5 新增的 #12 和 #13；② `guides/console-development.md` 末尾新增的「Local dev and per-agent stacks」节；③ `guides/flaky-tests.md`；④ `ui/CLAUDE.md` 的一句话；⑤ `console-development.md`「Debugging & Browser Simulation Strategy」的 Rule #1（S1）。
- 两分钟验证：在仓根跑 `git diff origin/main...HEAD --color-moved=dimmed-zebra -- ui`。预期搬迁的行显示为 moved。没标 moved 的增删行只有下文列出的修正行和新写的指针、规则行。
- 需要你做的：审批这个 Tier H PR（`ui/AGENTS.md`、`ui/.claude/**`）。

## What changes

`ui/AGENTS.md` goes from 36,140 bytes over 261 lines to **32,591 bytes over 221 lines**, measured at head `dbb5e1cb`. There is no cap (6485892110).

**Stays in the core:** §1–§8 in full, plus the rule-bearing parts of §9: Housekeeping, the test-running subsection, and the 测试纪律 rules. Each rule appears once. Where a rule already named its instrument (`pnpm check:*`, a test file, a lint rule), the pointer stays where it was. No pointer was added to an existing line, because that would reword it.

**New text:**
- §5 gets two writing rules from 6407900763 item 2, written as prose:
  - **#12**: a comment in a workflow or a script is one line of why plus a link.
  - **#13**: code comments state invariants, not incident history.

  Each says that no gate holds it and that existing comments are not swept. Neither contains ⛔ or "never", so the census is unchanged.
- `ui/CLAUDE.md`: its one line now reads "AGENTS.md is the source of truth for what differs under ui/ — it and the topic pages it links to are one instruction set, maintained in one place, under the root AGENTS.md" (6407900763 item 1; contract-review S3 6502595750, ruling 6503029051; surface widened by the seat for this file only). No rule is restated there.
- One pointer line per topic page, in §9: one under 测试纪律 and one in a new `### Local dev and per-agent stacks` stub.
- One row in the `objectui-contributor` SKILL.md topic table for the new guide.

### Moved-block map (byte-preserving)

| From `ui/AGENTS.md` | To |
|---|---|
| §9 `### Local dev — console UI ↔ backend (read before debugging UI)`: the heading and its 7 bullets | `ui/.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/console-development.md`, under a new `## Local dev and per-agent stacks` |
| §9 `### 每个 agent 独立测试栈(端口隔离,多 agent 并行的推荐做法)`: the whole subsection, 4 steps and the **纪律** paragraph | same new section, after the block above |
| §9 测试纪律, the opening paragraph (the 976 ms / 1000 ms measurement) | new `ui/.claude/skills/objectui-contributor/guides/flaky-tests.md` |
| §9 测试纪律, the 「失败现场会直接指认根因」 bullet and the 「顺手体检」 bullet | `guides/flaky-tests.md` |
| §9 测试纪律, the 「前情:objectui#3010」 line | `guides/flaky-tests.md` |

Nothing went to `docs/postmortems/`. The only incident write-up in the file is the one-line 前情 note, and it went with its section's reasoning into `flaky-tests.md`.

**Move proof.** Run `git diff origin/main...HEAD --color-moved=plain -- ui`. Of the 134 changed lines (blank lines included), 103 are marked moved. A second script compared the 57 removed lines against the added lines. Every removed non-blank line reappears byte-identical, except 9, and those 9 are exactly the stale-claim lines below. The full `dimmed-zebra` output is reproducible with the command in 维护者速读.

### Stale claims fixed (the only rewording; reading 6455483141)

1. **The `:3001/_console` claim (moved to `console-development.md`).** It now says the backend serves `/_console` on its own port (`:3000` in the single-stack setup). The built Console is still named as real, by its package: 「仓根 `@objectstack/console` 包的 `dist/`」. The package spelling replaces the literal root path because `ui/scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs` resolves a `packages/` token against `ui/`. Once the line moved under its scan root, that gate went red on the root-relative path, which is unbuilt in a fresh checkout anyway. The package spelling keeps the claim and resolves cleanly.
2. **§7 MSW bullet.** It now says there is no `@objectstack/plugin-msw` package and no `msw` dependency in the workspace. It points to the real-backend stacks in the console guide and keeps the instruction not to hand-roll fetch interceptors.
3. **§2 styling path.** `skills/objectui/rules/styling.md` now says "at the repository root". The file's preamble reads paths relative to `ui/`.
4. **§5 #8.** `app-shell/src/urlParams.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/urlParams.ts`. This is a census line. The dispatch ordered this fix, so the line differs from before by exactly those 9 bytes.
5. **§6 registry snippet.** The path is now `packages/core/src/registry/Registry.ts`. The invented `registerComponent` / `resolveComponent` Map snippet is replaced by an abridged view of the real `Registry` class (`register`, `registerLazy`, `get`) and the `ComponentRegistry` singleton. The renderer-loop snippet's one call to the removed `resolveComponent` becomes `ComponentRegistry.get(schema.type)`, which is what `SchemaRenderer.tsx` calls. Without that change the snippet would name a function that no longer exists anywhere in the file.
6. **Contract-review S1 (6502595750, ruling 6503029051).** `console-development.md` § Debugging & Browser Simulation Strategy no longer claims a mock mode or an MSW plugin. Rule #1 is retitled «No MSW plugin — debug against a real backend» and points to «Local dev and per-agent stacks». The MSWPlugin Configuration bullet is removed. Rule #2 Alignment now names the `/api` proxy target (`DEV_PROXY_TARGET`) instead of a mock server. The SKILL.md row says «debugging against a real backend».

### ⛔ / never census (case-insensitive `⛔|never`, one count per line)

| | lines | bytes of those lines | sha256 of the line set (first 16) |
|---|---|---|---|
| before, `origin/main` `72b08eec` (identical to `ad3a640e35` for this file) | **27** | 16,789 | `5c6693bd42200de7` |
| after, head `261449bc` (byte-identical to `ccc751c5` and `dbb5e1cb` for this file, 32,591 B), all in the core | **27** | 16,798 | `4a9f74261366934b` |

27 = 27: 26 lines byte-identical and in the same order, plus 1 that differs only by the ordered path fix. That line is §5 #8 ("UI state lives where it can survive"): its path `app-shell/src/urlParams.ts` gained the 9-byte prefix `packages/`, which is why the line set grows 16,789 → 16,798 bytes. The fix was ordered by the dispatch (reading 6455483141) because the old path does not resolve from `ui/`, and the seat kept it (OQ2 → A). No ⛔ / never line moved out of the core.

### Dependent reader

`scripts/check-agent-test-spelling.mjs` `COUNTER_EXAMPLE_FILES` names `ui/AGENTS.md` for trap two (陷阱二). That bullet stays in the core with the rest of the test-running subsection, so the script and its test need no edit. `pnpm check:agent-test-spelling` passes and reports `1 declared counter-example(s)`.

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/__tests__/check-skills-paths.test.ts scripts/__tests__/check-shell-escape-residue.test.ts scripts/__tests__/check-doc-links.test.ts`: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 196 passed (196). The lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Under `ui/`, three scripts exit 0:
  - `node scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs`: 86/87 stated paths resolve, 1 baselined.
  - `node scripts/check-shell-escape-residue.mjs`
  - `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs`: "Links are valid across 14 scan roots."

## Acceptance notes

- **The core is still large.** It is about 32.6 KB, because the 27 whole ⛔ / never lines alone are 16.8 KB and §5 carries most of them. The test-running subsection and the i18n-regex bullet stay whole. The first holds the dependent reader's counter-example and a 「上面的形态」 back-reference. The second states a rule inside the incident that proved it, and splitting it would reword a line.
- **Stale claims outside this card's list were left alone:**
  - The published `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` still names `@objectstack/plugin-msw` (the seat files it). The `console-development.md` half was fixed here as S1.
  - The heading «Which console `:3001/_console` serves» in root-side `docs/agents/build-and-test.md` still names `:3001`.
  - §7's surviving census line still says "matches the mock server". Census lines stay verbatim.
- **Trailers.** The commits carry the model-free pair the root `AGENTS.md` requires.
